_llm_instructions: Fill in the 'project_title' and 'date_prepared' properties, and the 'value' property of each field, based on the provided project context. Reference parameters.md for global project variables.
form_name: Team Psychological Safety and Wellbeing Index

f01_Assessment_Period_and_Cadence.label: Assessment Period and Cadence
f01_Assessment_Period_and_Cadence.guidance: The evaluation sprint, sprint cadence, and designated survey period for measuring team psychological safety and cognitive well-being.

f02_Facilitator_and_Working_Model.label: Facilitator and Working Model
f02_Facilitator_and_Working_Model.guidance: The designated agile coach, scrum master, or people lead facilitating the assessment, and the team's working arrangement (Co-located, Hybrid, or Fully Remote).

f03_Team_Response_Participation_Rate.label: Team Response Participation Rate
f03_Team_Response_Participation_Rate.guidance: The percentage of team members participating in the anonymous assessment to validate sample representation.

f04_Vulnerability_and_Open_Inquiry_Score.label: Vulnerability and Open Inquiry Score
f04_Vulnerability_and_Open_Inquiry_Score.guidance: Aggregated rating reflecting team members' comfort in asking questions, admitting mistakes, and seeking help without fear of penalty.

f05_Constructive_Dissent_and_Innovation_.label: Constructive Dissent and Innovation Score
f05_Constructive_Dissent_and_Innovation_.guidance: Aggregated rating reflecting psychological comfort in challenging assumptions, proposing novel ideas, and offering dissenting views.

f06_Blameless_Culture_and_Mutual_Support.label: Blameless Culture and Mutual Support Score
f06_Blameless_Culture_and_Mutual_Support.guidance: Aggregated rating reflecting perceived team trust, peer collaboration, and constructive root-cause problem solving.

f07_Cognitive_Load_and_Overtime_Health.label: Cognitive Load and Overtime Health
f07_Cognitive_Load_and_Overtime_Health.guidance: Quantitative assessment of sustained work pressure, cognitive context-switching frequency, and overtime hours worked.

f08_Focus_Time_and_Meeting_Load_Ratio.label: Focus Time and Meeting Load Ratio
f08_Focus_Time_and_Meeting_Load_Ratio.guidance: Ratio of uninterrupted deep-work focus time compared to total hours spent in synchronous meetings and ceremonies.

f09_Well_being_Action_and_Working_Agreem.label: Well-being Action and Working Agreement Update
f09_Well_being_Action_and_Working_Agreem.guidance: Agreed interventions, meeting hygiene rules, focus-block policies, or team charter amendments enacted to protect team vitality.
